title: 500 Yen Coins
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

Takahashi has $K$ $500$-yen coins. (Yen is the currency of Japan.) If these coins add up to $X$ yen or more, print `Yes`; otherwise, print `No`.

## Constraints

- $1 \leq K \leq 100$
- $1 \leq X \leq 10^5$

## Input

Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
K X
```

## Output

If the coins add up to $X$ yen or more, print `Yes`; otherwise, print `No`.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

高桥有 $K$ 枚 $500$ 日元硬币。（日元是日本的货币。）如果这些硬币的总金额不少于 $X$ 日元，则输出 `Yes`；否则输出 `No`。

## 约束条件

- $1 \leq K \leq 100$
- $1 \leq X \leq 10^5$

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
K X
```

## 输出格式

如果这些硬币的总金额不少于 $X$ 日元，则输出 `Yes`；否则输出 `No`。

samples.note: Two $500$-yen coins add up to $1000$ yen, which is not less than $X = 900$ yen.
One $500$-yen coin is worth $500$ yen, which is less than $X = 501$ yen.
Four $500$-yen coins add up to $2000$ yen, which is not less than $X = 2000$ yen.
